name: Stranger Tavern - Brawl
description:
About This Game

Welcome to the time-warped 《Stranger Tavern - Brawl》! Where deities converge and brawls cost nothing.

We've crammed pantheons into one tavern, turning auto-chess into a divine showdown. Assemble teams, arrange formations, trigger synergies—unleash your celestial squad to asynchronously obliterate players worldwide. This is an unstoppable game of permutations, a thrilling odyssey of divine combat and strategic domination!

Six summoners preside, each capable of rewriting the rules themselves! Choose your captain wisely to match your formation style, and watch your power soar. Chose poorly? Time to restart.

Robin Hood: Archer sovereign—proximity amplifies his firepower, the quintessential choice for ranged devastation.

King Arthur: Round Table shield commander—tight formations stack shields to the brim, the anchor of fortress lineups.

Little Match Girl: Attack-speed demon—closer proximity accelerates her tempo, the rhythm engine of speed-based strategies.

Dracula's Cousin: Vampiric crit queen—her presence detonates critical damage, the soul of Bloody Mary Enthusiast builds.

Cleopatra: Mage alliance leader—proximity elevates crit rates, transforming spells into cascading explosions.

Leonidas: Spartan juggernaut—nearness thickens health bars, the ultimate answer for frontline tanking.

Olympian gods, Asgardian warriors, Eastern sword immortals, Lovecraftian horrors... all await your summons at the bar! "Bloodthirsty Berserker" red-eyed brutes, "Gold Tycoon" counting coins till cramps set in, "Turtle Reflect" professional insurance fraudsters, "Devouring Behemoth" sacrificing allies for boundless mana... wreak havoc as you please—the tavern disclaims all liability.

Don't assume casual placement suffices! Frontline tanking, backline damage, flanking maneuvers—select correctly to unlock hidden synergies: attributes surge, even new skills emerge. Precise positioning turns tides; one misplaced unit collapses everything. Strategy begins the moment you arrange the seating.

A vast roster of mythic heroes and attribute cards already exists, but this is merely the appetizer—our kitchen knows no limits beyond your imagination, perpetually updating! Your card pool grows ever more absurd, strategies increasingly abstract.

Asynchronous PVP ladder now open—challenge saved formations from players worldwide anytime! Every bizarre build can reign supreme here. Victory climbs ranks and reaps rewards; defeat? The rival tavern stays open tonight.

Prove to the world: your tavern is the most outrageous of them all!
short_desc: Welcome to the Tavern of Wonders! Olympian deities, Norse war gods, Eastern warriors, Cthulhu horrors... all await your command. Assemble any team—misplace them? Power unleashed! Asynchronous PVP lets you challenge bizarre lineups from players worldwide. Whose tavern reigns supreme in absurdity?
